l4Discriminating.text: True physical oscillation or modulation with ~10–14 day period affecting pendulum apparatus selectively; baseline (days 1–10) samples only initial equilibration; day 12 marks entry into elevated plateau or oscillation regime. — Both pendulum instruments show synchronized upward step at day 12 (z ≈ 33 and z ≈ 23), with today's pendulum_lab readings (trials 373–378: n=6, mean ≈ 1.7218) remaining in elevated regime consistent with post-baseline mean 1.7231. A genuine 10–14 day gravitational, Coriolis, or structural modulation selective to pendulum dynamics could explain the sustained elevation and apparatus selectivity (resonators insensitive to same mechanism). However, this hypothesis faces severe difficulty: genuine periodic or stepped physical modulation should PRESERVE temporal coherence in the true acquisition sequence and INCREASE lag-1/lag-2 autocorrelations near the transition boundary. Observed lag-2 autocorrelation collapse to chance levels across all instruments contradicts this prediction. Event-ID scrambling (H1) directly accounts for both the autocorrelation anomaly AND the synchronized shift more parsimoniously. Probability reduced from 0.08 to 0.10 (slight increase from 0.07 to reflect residual possibility that true physical phenomenon occurs AND archive is scrambled).
